messages:
jena: Heads-up: started seeing a weird crash in our Expo sample when loading remote images + streaming responses. Hermes error points at `crypto.getRandomValues` when a fetch stream is consumed. Full reload is fine, fast refresh or JS bundle swap triggers it.

sam: interesting combo. Are you using any ReadableStream/polyfill for RN? Some libs pull `node:crypto` or rely on globalThis.crypto during stream plumbing.

jena: stack shows `ReadableStreamDefaultReader.read` -> lib code -> call to a util that does `crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16))`. We do ship `react-native-get-random-values` in App entry, but the sample uses expo-asset + an image-stream helper that lazy-requires the helper.

kevin: lazy require + fast refresh = race where the helper runs before the app-level imports. Also Metro can bundle the CJS path that assumes Node builtins. Did you check package `exports` and `react-native` entry?

maria: our SDK package had only ESM and CJS entries for web/node. No RN export. We added a thin `rn/index.js` in dist that imports `react-native-get-random-values` and re-exports the RN helpers. Fixing imports in sample to `import '@redwood/inference/rn'` fixed it for me.

sam: nicer is adding conditional exports so consumers just `import from '@redwood/inference'` and Metro picks RN entry: e.g. \"exports\": { \".\": { \"import\": \"./dist/index.mjs\", \"require\": \"./dist/index.cjs.js\", \"react-native\": \"./dist/rn/index.js\" } } . Also include a tiny synchronous guard in rn/index that sets up polyfills immediately: `if (!globalThis.crypto) require('react-native-get-random-values')`.

kevin: another wrinkle: some bundlers and older Expo SDKs ignore `exports` -> add a root-level `react-native` field or a `react-native.js` at package root that re-exports dist/rn/index.js to be extra compatible.

jena: typings issue came up too. TS in RN sample complained about `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` shape. Our d.ts used `export =` in legacy output. Moving to `export default` style in the ESM d.ts and publishing a separate `index.d.ts` for RN cleared it.

maria: note for streaming: when using `fetch` streaming in RN, avoid referencing crypto in small hot-loaded helpers. Prefer a single shared util that your app imports at startup. That reduces surface for fast-refresh races.

devex-bot: Automated note: linked sample-e2e ticket #842 for Expo fast-refresh streaming flake. CI impacted: ios-expo-fast-refresh.

jena: created PR that adds rn export + sync polyfill guard + docs note for onboarding. Will ping for reviews. Thanks all! :tada:
